company.description:
MAXION is changing dating app behaviors for busy, accomplished professionals. By eliminating swiping, messaging, ghosting, and facilitating in-person dates to expedite the process of finding compatible partners in expat-dominated cities in the GCC.

MAXION is already live six months in only Dubai and we broke into five-figure revenue on the App Store in our fifth month!! We have 1500+ monthly active users and are currently raising to expand into new markets and open new portals.
